notes.title: DHXP 2025 Anniversary event
notes.content:
Thank you for sticking with us all these years!

It's been over a decade since we began this journey, as this month marks eleven years of Digital Happiness' first-ever launched title, DreadOut. What started as a small spark has grown into a world of stories and shared memories with you, our beloved players.

Everything we've built was made with passion, sleepless nights, and LOTS of coffee. And through it all, you've been there playing, supporting, and believing in us.

DHXP is the pulse of everything we’ve created so far. And to this day, it has always been more than a celebration, it’s a thank you, a look back, and a vision of what lies ahead.

And for you, thank you for being part of this journey. Whether you’ve been here since the beginning, or you just stumbled into our world someway somehow, we're glad you're here.

Then what lies beyond the 11th year?

This is the fun part. Currently, there are so many things going on in our headquarters, and we're so excited to share them with you. We're working on titles that you might have expected and not expected!

[previewyoutube=uYlkB3py6EE;full][/previewyoutube]

Also check out the DHXP 2025 Steam Sale Page by clicking the banner below:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371531/f6f256432d7ba3a4c98fa44749cb058a7bd9463e.jpg

Did someone mention sale?
Of course, we have a special sale going on too! Take a look around and dive into the games that have shaped us as a developers. You can get it with up to 80% off!

Please spread the news because this offer lasts through May 24, 2025!

Hope you enjoy every bit of it!

:DH

notes.title: Red Lantern and Gold Coins - DreadHaunt Update 20240212
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/5a0bf7efea472448e26d4283efffecd923b86b91.png

Greetings, Agents!

First of all, happy Lunar New Year! And now, the HQ is presenting news regarding DreadHaunt’s latest update, just in time for this festivities!


Seasonal Environment – CNY

Embrace the spirit of the Lunar New Year with the new seasonal ornament! We hope that this seasonal environment will freshen up your haunting sessions. We even managed to snap some footage directly from the field.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/56797effdfd5768a62fb2436a7002d8da5bc4d30.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/b6f56fbad7faa8340811599c67dda00b88916299.jpg


Bug Fixes and Improvements

As usual, We squashed some bugs and fine-tuned several aspects to ensure smooth gameplay. However, don’t hesitate to reach out if you have feedback and suggestions!


Future Update Sneak Peek

Based on the timeline that we shared, the single-player mode is in the works. We’re also working on the game economy like XP accumulation and cosmetics rewards.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1855580/extras/content_release_plan_fixed.jpg?t=1703069105

That is all for now. Thank you for your continued support for DreadHaunt!

notes.title: DreadHaunt Update 2023-12-20
notes.content:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33371531/07d380d2395eacdd707e403d3e5806bfd69af98a.png
Good day, Agents.

We have updated DreadHaunt to version 20231218, and these are notable details that the HQ want to share:

Post-Session Results Screen

After each session, you’ll be presented with an eye-catching post-result screen. Showing who’s the possessed one, who survived (or didn’t), and how many points you racked up during the mission. 

(Ongoing) Audio Updates

We decided to overhaul the Audio System including BGM & SFX assets. You will notice a few changes during gameplay

(Ongoing) Controller Support

Controller support is available in very early stage. If you the controller-wielding type of agent, we are looking forward to hear your experiences!

Bug Fixes, Here and There

- Added subtitle size option to Settings.
- Spectro damage effect +15%
- Kunti attack charge 25 -> 28.75
- Asih attack charge 10 -> 11.5
- Prevent drop tools while opening voter
- BugFix: Kunti attack charge hit multiple times
- Add condition to disable host quit button when in game
- add descriptions to sprectro skills
- fix mouse cursor not reappearing during waiting for players

Known Bugs/Glitches

- BGM not playing on Versus Mode
- etc.

Sneak Peek of Future Contents

We have a Content Update Plans on the DreadHaunt store page, check it out here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1855580/DreadHaunt/

Last but not least, if you have any suggestions or experienced bugs or glitches about the game, Feel free to reach us out on Steam Community Forum and our official discord server at discord.gg/dreaduniverse

notes.title: DreadHaunt Playtest is open during Steam Scream Fest!
notes.content:
Hi Agents! 

To commemorate Steam Scream Fest, DreadHaunt Playtest is open until 1 November! 

With this playtest phase. There are some gameplay features you can try, which are:

- Gameplay modifier tarot system. choose several modifiers that will change the vibe of every game session. 

- Preview of the session ending screen and merit points distribution.

- Reworked several possessed abilities.

- QoL update: character & environment polishing. bugfixes, etc

I hope you enjoy the playtest! If you have feedback go to the steam community hub or discord.gg/dreaduniverse. Also, bring your friends to survive together and wishlist DreadHaunt!
